O botão do plano mostra o EXPLAIN do com: The plan button shows the EXPLAIN of the command at the cursor (PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite): how the database will read the data.

Servidor interno com certificado próprio: Internal server with its own certificate? Turn on TLS and turn off Verify the certificate (encrypt only), or choose the company certificate authority (CA) file. If the server asks for a client certificate, choose the certificate and the key.
Clique no nome de uma coluna para ordena: Click a column name to sort (again reverses, a third time returns to the database order). Filter rows hides the ones without the text.
Na tabela aberta com clique duplo (Postg: In a table opened with a double click (PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite, with a primary key), double-click a cell to change the value. Enter keeps it, Esc gives up and the NULL button empties it.
As células mudadas ficam marcadas. Salva: Changed cells stay marked. Save shows the UPDATEs before writing; if one fails, none is written.
A aba SQL mostra o CREATE TABLE (ou CREA: The SQL tab shows the CREATE TABLE (or CREATE VIEW) of the open table, to copy or put in the editor.

Botão direito na conexão ou no banco: No: Right-click the connection or database: New view, New materialized view (PostgreSQL) and New function open a template in a new tab. If the command at the cursor is a SELECT, the view comes with it.
Uma view é uma consulta guardada com nom: A view is a saved, named query: every time you read it, it runs again. A materialized view stores the result: reading is fast, but the data only changes with Refresh the data (REFRESH), in its right-click menu.
As funções do banco (PostgreSQL e MySQL): The database functions (PostgreSQL and MySQL) appear in the tree, below the tables. Click one to open its code in a tab and change it.
Funções e views materializadas na árvore: Functions and materialized views in the tree; templates for view, materialized view and function.
Rodar um arquivo .sql sem abrir: Run a .sql file without opening it
Também dá para rodar um arquivo .sql int: You can also run a whole .sql file without opening it (the button next to the floppy).
Depois de CREATE, ALTER ou DROP a árvore: After CREATE, ALTER or DROP the tree reads the database again on its own: the new table shows up. Right-click a table also renames it (showing the SQL first).
Rodar um arquivo .sql sem abrir; renomea: Run a .sql file without opening it; rename a table from the tree; the tree refreshes itself after CREATE, ALTER and DROP.
Auto-commit saves each command right away. In manual mode, changes only stay after Commit.

Faça Commit ou Rollback antes de voltar: Commit or roll back before going back to auto-commit.
